title: proverb — boundary

sentences.sentence: An old Arab proverb says, "The enemy of my enemy is my friend."
sentences.translation: 有一句古老的阿拉伯谚语说：“我敌人的敌人是我的朋友。”

sentences.sentence: Land rose from its womb, usurped its throne, and ever since the maddened old creature, with hoary crest of foam, wails and laments continually, like King Lear exposed to the fury of the elements.
sentences.translation: 大地从它的腹中隆起，篡夺了它的王位。 从那以后，暴怒的老家伙就开始顶着灰白色的泡沫不断的哀号恸哭，一如暴风骤雨之中的李尔王。

sentences.sentence: The original ending of King Lear wasn’t performed for nearly 150 years because it was thought too upsetting.
sentences.translation: 《李尔王》的原始结尾在长达150年的时间里没有上演过，因为人们认为它太悲伤了。

sentences.sentence: hard-working, respectable people
sentences.translation: 勤勉可敬的人

sentences.sentence: ...accusations that he had been disrespectful to a police officer.
sentences.translation: ...关于他曾对一名警官无礼的控告。

sentences.sentence: It jumped up and down disrespectfully, mocking the hunting soldiers. It threw a nut at them.
sentences.translation: 它无礼地上窜下跳，戏弄士兵们，还朝他们扔果核。

sentences.sentence: They caballed against the emperor's edict.
sentences.translation: 他们密谋反对皇帝的谕旨。

sentences.sentence: The daughter of an emperor does not worry about finding a husband.
sentences.translation: 皇帝女儿不愁嫁。

sentences.sentence: The old chancellor who had offended against the emperor was relegated to the distant boundaries of the country.
sentences.translation: 触犯了皇帝的老宰相被流放到遥远的边疆。

sentences.sentence: The days are shortening.
sentences.translation: 白天变得越来越短了。

sentences.sentence: They need more funds to modernize the country’s telephone system.
sentences.translation: 他们需要更多的资金将本国的电话系统现代化。

sentences.sentence: a tastefully modernized old farmhouse
sentences.translation: 雅致而现代化的旧农舍

sentences.sentence: He is next in line to the throne (= will become king when the present ruler dies ) .
sentences.translation: 他是第一王位继承人。

sentences.sentence: In 1913, George V was on the throne (= was ruling ) .
sentences.translation: 1913年乔治五世在位。

sentences.sentence: She also says that on one occasion, Regan hung up on her in the middle of a phone conversation.
sentences.translation: 她还表示，有一次，在电话交谈中，里根挂了她的电话。

sentences.sentence: This part is equal in value to what I give to Goneril.
sentences.translation: 这部份和我给贡纳莉的那部份价值相等。

sentences.sentence: Don't grudge Anne Cordelia her fancies, Diana. I'm always sorry for children who don't spend a few years in fairyland.
sentences.translation: 不要对安妮.科迪莉亚的想象力不满，戴安娜，我总是为没有在童话世界中度过一段岁月的孩子感到遗憾。

phrases.translation: 打架；一决雌雄；用拳头猛击

sentences.sentence: the Duke of Norfolk
sentences.translation: 诺福克公爵

sentences.sentence: One of my students from Albany, NY was suffering from bouts of severe depression.
sentences.translation: 我一个来自纽约奥尔巴尼的学生曾患有严重的抑郁症。

sentences.sentence: Prince Charles leads an expensive life and the Duchy of Cornwall is there to fund it.
sentences.translation: 查尔斯王子过着一种奢侈的生活，这些都由康沃尔公国进行资助。

sentences.sentence: But the move to abolish shared berths for rail passengers travelling alone from London to Cornwall shows that, like Greta Garbo, we all now want to be alone.
sentences.translation: 但废除从伦敦到康沃尔的单身旅行者共用铺位的运动却表明，如同葛丽泰·嘉宝那样，现在的我们希望独处。

sentences.sentence: The most extraordinary safari I ever organised for Abercrombie and Kent was in 1993 when I took Bill and Melinda Gates round East Africa.
sentences.translation: 我为阿伯克龙比和肯特组织的最特别的猎游是1993年的时候，当时我带比尔盖茨夫妇去东非。

phrases.translation: 举证责任；提供证据之责任
n. 财政负担，经济负担

sentences.sentence: His family responsibilities had started to become a burden.
sentences.translation: 家庭责任已开始成为他的负担。

sentences.sentence: I wouldn't dare hand this project over to anyone else.
sentences.translation: 我可不敢将这个项目交给其他任何人负责。

phrases.translation: 责任会计；权责单位会计制

sentences.sentence: Kelly’s promotion means more money and more responsibility.
sentences.translation: 凯利获得提升，这意味着钱多了，责任也更大了。

sentences.sentence: National boundaries are becoming increasingly meaningless in the global economy.
sentences.translation: 在全球经济中，国界已经变得越来越没有意义。

sentences.sentence: We would need their agreement to build outside the city boundary .
sentences.translation: 我们在市界以外的地方建房需要他们批准。

sentences.sentence: The stream curves round to mark the boundary of his property.
sentences.translation: 小河打了个弯，为他这块地划出了边界。

sentences.sentence: Anything that crosses the boundary of a black hole cannot get back.
sentences.translation: 任何物质只要跨越黑洞的界线就再也无法出来。

sentences.sentence: We walked through the churchyard towards the boundary wall .
sentences.translation: 我们穿过教堂墓地，向院墙走去。

sentences.sentence: The property’s boundary line is 25 feet from the back of the house.
sentences.translation: 这块地产的边界线在屋后25英尺的地方。

sentences.sentence: boundary disputes between neighbouring countries
sentences.translation: 邻国之间的边界争端

text:
英语词汇 · 人教高中 · 第 165 单元

proverb
音标：英 /'prɒvɜːb/  美 /'prɑvɝb/
n. 谚语
短语：as the proverb goes — 有句谚语说道；俗话说
例句：An old Arab proverb says, "The enemy of my enemy is my friend."
有一句古老的阿拉伯谚语说：“我敌人的敌人是我的朋友。”

King Lear
李尔王
例句：Land rose from its womb, usurped its throne, and ever since the maddened old creature, with hoary crest of foam, wails and laments continually, like King Lear exposed to the fury of the elements.
大地从它的腹中隆起，篡夺了它的王位。 从那以后，暴怒的老家伙就开始顶着灰白色的泡沫不断的哀号恸哭，一如暴风骤雨之中的李尔王。
例句：The original ending of King Lear wasn’t performed for nearly 150 years because it was thought too upsetting.
《李尔王》的原始结尾在长达150年的时间里没有上演过，因为人们认为它太悲伤了。

respectful
音标：英 /rɪ'spek(t)fʊl; -f(ə)l/  美 /rɪ'spɛktfəl/
adj. 尊敬的，恭敬的
例句：hard-working, respectable people
勤勉可敬的人

disrespectful
音标：英 /dɪsrɪ'spek(t)f(ʊ)l/  美 /disri,spektful/
adj. 失礼的，无礼的
例句：...accusations that he had been disrespectful to a police officer.
...关于他曾对一名警官无礼的控告。

disrespectfully
adv. 失礼地，无理地
例句：It jumped up and down disrespectfully, mocking the hunting soldiers. It threw a nut at them.
它无礼地上窜下跳，戏弄士兵们，还朝他们扔果核。

emperor
音标：英 /ˈempərə(r)/  美 /'ɛmpərɚ/
n. 皇帝，君主
短语：emperor penguin — n. 皇企鹅
例句：They caballed against the emperor's edict.
他们密谋反对皇帝的谕旨。
例句：The daughter of an emperor does not worry about finding a husband.
皇帝女儿不愁嫁。
例句：The old chancellor who had offended against the emperor was relegated to the distant boundaries of the country.
触犯了皇帝的老宰相被流放到遥远的边疆。

shorten
音标：英 /'ʃɔːt(ə)n/  美 /'ʃɔrtn/
v. 缩短，使变短
例句：The days are shortening.
白天变得越来越短了。

modernize
音标：英 /ˈmɒdənaɪz/  美 /mɑdɚnˌaɪz/
vt. 使现代化
例句：They need more funds to modernize the country’s telephone system.
他们需要更多的资金将本国的电话系统现代化。
例句：a tastefully modernized old farmhouse
雅致而现代化的旧农舍

throne
音标：英 /θrəʊn/  美 /θron/
n. 王座，王位
短语：frozen throne — 冰封王座（游戏名称）
短语：take the throne — 登基为王，加冕为王
例句：He is next in line to the throne (= will become king when the present ruler dies ) .
他是第一王位继承人。
例句：In 1913, George V was on the throne (= was ruling ) .
1913年乔治五世在位。

Regan
里根
例句：She also says that on one occasion, Regan hung up on her in the middle of a phone conversation.
她还表示，有一次，在电话交谈中，里根挂了她的电话。

Goneril
音标：英 /'ɡɔnəril/  美 /'ɡɔnəril/
贡纳莉
例句：This part is equal in value to what I give to Goneril.
这部份和我给贡纳莉的那部份价值相等。

Cordelia
音标：英 /kɔ:'di:ljə/  美 /kɔ:'di:ljə/
科迪莉亚
例句：Don't grudge Anne Cordelia her fancies, Diana. I'm always sorry for children who don't spend a few years in fairyland.
不要对安妮.科迪莉亚的想象力不满，戴安娜，我总是为没有在童话世界中度过一段岁月的孩子感到遗憾。

duke
音标：英 /djuːk/  美 /dʊk/
n. 公爵
短语：duke university — 杜克大学
短语：duke it out — 打架；一决雌雄；用拳头猛击
例句：the Duke of Norfolk
诺福克公爵

Albany
音标：英 /'ɔ:bəni/  美 /'ɔ:bəni/
奥尔巴尼
例句：One of my students from Albany, NY was suffering from bouts of severe depression.
我一个来自纽约奥尔巴尼的学生曾患有严重的抑郁症。

Cornwall
音标：英 /'kɔ:nwɔ:l/  美 /'kɔ:nwɔ:l/
康沃尔
例句：Prince Charles leads an expensive life and the Duchy of Cornwall is there to fund it.
查尔斯王子过着一种奢侈的生活，这些都由康沃尔公国进行资助。
例句：But the move to abolish shared berths for rail passengers travelling alone from London to Cornwall shows that, like Greta Garbo, we all now want to be alone.
但废除从伦敦到康沃尔的单身旅行者共用铺位的运动却表明，如同葛丽泰·嘉宝那样，现在的我们希望独处。

Kent
音标：英 /kent/  美 /kent/
n. 肯特
例句：The most extraordinary safari I ever organised for Abercrombie and Kent was in 1993 when I took Bill and Melinda Gates round East Africa.
我为阿伯克龙比和肯特组织的最特别的猎游是1993年的时候，当时我带比尔盖茨夫妇去东非。

burden
音标：英 /'bɜːd(ə)n/  美 /'bɝdn/
n. 负担，担子
短语：heavy burden — 重负；重炉料
短语：burden of proof — 举证责任；提供证据之责任
短语：tax burden — 课税负担
短语：financial burden — n. 财政负担，经济负担
短语：economic burden — 经济负担
短语：beast of burden — 驮兽（如马、驴等）
短语：burden of persuasion — 说服责任；举证责任
例句：His family responsibilities had started to become a burden.
家庭责任已开始成为他的负担。

hand over
音标：英 /'hænd,əuvə(r)/  美 /'hænd,əuvə(r)/
移交（权力、责任）
例句：I wouldn't dare hand this project over to anyone else.
我可不敢将这个项目交给其他任何人负责。

responsibility
音标：英 /rɪˌspɒnsəˈbɪlətɪ/  美 /rɪˌspɑːnsəˈbɪləti/
n. 责任，职责
短语：responsibility for — 责任；负责
短语：sense of responsibility — 责任感，责任心
短语：social responsibility — 社会责任
短语：responsibility system — 责任制
短语：take responsibility — 承担责任
短语：legal responsibility — 法律责任
短语：take responsibility for — 对…负责
短语：criminal responsibility — 刑事责任
短语：corporate social responsibility — 企业的社会责任
短语：personal responsibility — 个人责任；人事责任
短语：assume responsibility — 承担责任
短语：with responsibility for — adv. 负责
短语：joint responsibility — 连带责任
短语：corporate responsibility — 公司责任；共同责任
短语：responsibility accounting — 责任会计；权责单位会计制
短语：financial responsibility — 经济责任；支付能力
短语：bear responsibility for — 对…负有责任
短语：responsibility center — 责任中心
短语：general manager responsibility system — 总经理负责制
短语：share responsibility — 分担责任；共同负责
例句：Kelly’s promotion means more money and more responsibility.
凯利获得提升，这意味着钱多了，责任也更大了。

boundary
音标：英 /'baʊnd(ə)rɪ/  美 /'baʊndri/
n. 边界，分界线
短语：boundary condition — 边界条件，界面条件
短语：boundary value — 边值；边界值
短语：boundary layer — 边界层
短语：boundary element method — 边界元法；边界要素法
短语：grain boundary — [冶]晶界
短语：boundary line — 边界线；疆界线
短语：moving boundary — 移动边界；移动界面
短语：turbulent boundary layer — 湍流边界层；紊两面层
短语：boundary surface — 界面；边界面
短语：outer boundary — 外边界
短语：boundary point — 边界点
短语：natural boundary — 自然边界
短语：plate boundary — 板块边缘，板块边界
短语：crystal boundary — 晶界；晶体间界
短语：lower boundary — 下边界
短语：boundary lubrication — 边界润滑
短语：phase boundary — 相界面；相界线
短语：boundary layer flow — 边界层怜；边界层流动
短语：upper boundary — 上边界
短语：boundary layer separation — 边界层分离（现象）
例句：National boundaries are becoming increasingly meaningless in the global economy.
在全球经济中，国界已经变得越来越没有意义。
例句：We would need their agreement to build outside the city boundary .
我们在市界以外的地方建房需要他们批准。
例句：The stream curves round to mark the boundary of his property.
小河打了个弯，为他这块地划出了边界。
例句：Anything that crosses the boundary of a black hole cannot get back.
任何物质只要跨越黑洞的界线就再也无法出来。
例句：We walked through the churchyard towards the boundary wall .
我们穿过教堂墓地，向院墙走去。
例句：The property’s boundary line is 25 feet from the back of the house.
这块地产的边界线在屋后25英尺的地方。
例句：boundary disputes between neighbouring countries
邻国之间的边界争端
